{"task":{"id":"Prob062_bugs_mux2","spec":"
Consider the following implementation of an 8-bit 2-to-1 mux:

  module TopModule (
      input        sel,
      input  [7:0] a,
      input  [7:0] b,
      output       out
  );

      assign out = (~sel & a) | (sel & b);

  endmodule

Unfortunately, this module has a bug. Implement a new version of this
module that fixes the bug.

Inline all helper logic inside TopModule; do not define auxiliary modules. xczu3eg-sbva484-1-e; 5 ns synthesis clock; simulator seed 1. Public interface erratum (p10-public-interface-062-v1): The public prompt requires an 8-bit 2-to-1 mux, but its buggy example declares out as one bit. Interpret out as an eight-bit output; sel remains a one-bit input and a and b remain eight-bit inputs.
